registerTables: UM5201 internal V0.8.8: 2-6 (RCC), 4-3 (HPSYS_AON ACR/ISSR), 5-4 (PA21), 9-7 (backup); pinned CMSIS DWT/DEMCR fields. Also 3-3 (PMUC trim register reset values/masks), 13-4 (EFUSE).
assumptions: Explicit secure architectural reset state and fresh backup-domain POR; not captured bootloader handoff.
Functional split cache with deterministic round-robin replacement; timing, allocation flags and replacement not silicon-verified.
Only Device, Normal noncacheable 0x44, write-through 0x22 and write-back 0xff memory attributes are supported.
Faults terminate the probe; runtime exception dispatch, complete peripheral clocks and board boot are not accepted.
HRC ready at application entry; HXT requested and settling for 48000 nominal 48MHz ticks by default. Configurable settling/failure, not calibrated silicon timing.
DWT cycle/CPI counters use estimated engine costs. Minimal debug feature contract and disabled SysTick at entry are assumptions; other trace/timer programming faults.

Documented LP_ACTIVE POR status is not LCPU execution or a controller response. LCPU controls now use an explicit active-domain/non-sleeping entry assumption, CPUWAIT initially clear; releasing it requires missing LCPU execution state.
EFUSE transfer estimate is 512 + THRCK PCLK ticks, not measured chip timing. Data must be supplied; no default calibration/identity is invented.
PMUC calibration models digital trim fields only, not measured analog voltages or regulator dynamics.

gates.resetRam: matches unchanged ELF/raw initializers and zero-fill
gates.systemInit: both revisions reach unchanged main with expected MPU/coprocessor/cache configuration
gates.earlyClockStartup: both images reach HAL_RCC_Reset_and_Halt_LCPU after source switch and 230us/30us DWT waits; internal consistency, not measured timing
gates.lcpuReset: both images assert and release reset once, retaining CPUWAIT; initial state is assumed, not captured
gates.calibration: synthetic fixtures match HAL byte transfer and PMUC trim mappings; physical calibration not verified
